claims.text: The source defines CLIP: joint ResNet/ViT image + Transformer text encoders trained by symmetric cross-entropy over NxN pairs on WIT-400M with learned temperature; text encoder synthesises zero-shot classifiers via prompt templates + embedding ensembling (in-context reference, not diffusion).
Reported numbers: zero-shot ImageNet 76.2% (matches ResNet-50), aYahoo 98.4, SUN 58.5; wins 16/27 vs ResNet-50 linear probe; STL10 99.3%.
